correctness.rationale: For every nonempty occupancy state, the first-event equation uses recovery rate |S| and transmission rate λ times the exact S-to-complement cut. The 15×15 rational symbolic inverse is solved from the true package verification.py and independently checked by a triangular Fraction recurrence through second order. The derived two rational functions subtract to λ² times an explicitly all-positive polynomial over an all-positive factored denominator at every λ>0. The general derivative follows from the zero-rate pure-death chain and mean cut size; quadratic motif structure follows from two edge-linear factors in the inverse expansion and permutation invariance. The graph-size minimum follows from classification of connected simple 3-edge four-vertex graphs; no unproved larger-graph ordering is claimed.

originality.rationale: The precise new scope is the graph-size-uniform weak-colonization link/motif hierarchy coupled with an all-positive-rate, equal-link-budget strict inequality for the first two nonisomorphic connected trees. The principal 2012 finite-graph paper concerns asymptotic lifetimes and does not imply this exact finite inequality; the closest 2015 article derives exact star/complete survival time and simulates path/star with 64 nodes under different rate normalizations. The 2013 complete/star metastability paper does not provide an exact four-vertex star–path comparison. Multiple targeted searches found no direct coverage. Algebraic matrix methods themselves and qualitative star/path differences are prior art. An unindexed exact small-graph calculation remains residual risk.
residual_risks: Earlier exhaustive small-graph contact-process tables or computer algebra notes may already contain these four-node rational expressions and their inequality without matching terminology.
Complete 2013 exact star paper text was not accessible; its stated abstract scope does not indicate a path comparison, but hidden coverage cannot be ruled out.
Strong ecological relevance is conceptual: field rates, heterogeneity and connectivity constraints are outside scope.

value.rationale: Patch-persistence risk can be compared at fixed patch count and fixed link budget. The result proves that edge count alone controls the entire first-order response to weak colonization, but the earliest topology dependence is a natural adjacent-edge motif, and it gives an exact sign for all colonization intensities on the smallest competing tree shapes. It is a structural ecological benchmark rather than an arbitrary parameter slice or merely a table of rational entries; no empirical field claim is made.
